$comment: SSOT for the synthetic grid-curve parameters shared by the TS and PY mock feeds. Hand-edited; regenerate data modules with `pnpm gen:data`. Floors are STYLIZED per-region annual-average carbon intensities (gCO2/kWh) used only to give each region's synthetic diurnal curve a plausible, distinct midpoint — they are round-number approximations of well-known public yearly averages (Ember / Electricity Maps, ~2024-2025) and are NOT live or authoritative data. utcOffsets are each region's standard-time UTC offset (from apps/web/src/lib/regions.ts); they shift each region's local-time trough (~05:00 local) to its UTC hour so multi-region simulations don't pile every cleanest-hour choice into one bucket.
